create_Alphabet: create an Alphabet instance with a custom character set, numerals, and special token mappings
create_GreekAlphabet: create a GreekAlphabet instance with Greek characters and tonos-to-oxia diacritic mappings
build_Greek_text_filter: build a Greek text filter that lowercases, normalizes diacritics, and converts ending sigma to final sigma
test_Alphabet_size_char: test the Alphabet size_char method to return the total number of character tokens in the vocabulary
test_Alphabet_size_word: test the Alphabet size_word method to return the total number of word tokens including the wordlist
